newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Finoutremer not to sell Tractebel shares.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Finoutremer not to sell Tractebel shares.

text.p: Belgian holding company Finoutremer said on Friday its management board decided unanimously not to sell its 154,178 shares in Belgian utility holding Tractebel to Societe Generale de Belgique's under SGB's ongoing public offer.

SGB, the Belgian flagship holding company, made a 14,500 franc per share offer, ending October 30, for the Tractebel stock it did not already own, when it announced it was buying a 24.47 percent stake in Tractebel from Groupe Bruxelles Lambert (GBL) and related companies.

To discourage the minority shareholders from accepting the public offer SGB said it would distribute to those shareholders a put warrant enabling them to sell their Tractebel shares under the same conditions as GBL in three years' time.
Tractebel shares closed at 14,775 francs on the Brussels bourse on Friday.
